parts.label: i
parts.text: (a) (i) On the diagram, sketch the graph of y x 2 2 = + for values of x between -3 and 3. [2]

content.tex: On the diagram, sketch the graph of \(y = x^{2} +2\) for values of \(x\) between \(-3\) and 3.
Find the coordinates of the local minimum.

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) On the diagram, sketch the graph of y x x x 5 2 3 2 = + - + for values of x between -3 and 3. [2]

content.tex: On the diagram, sketch the graph of \(y = x^{3} +x^{2} -5x+2\) for values of \(x\) between \(-3\) and 3.
